title: Asks you to share an OTP, PIN or password
why: Nobody from a bank, app or government office ever needs your OTP, PIN or password. Anyone asking for it is trying to move money out of your account.
examples: Please share the OTP you just received to complete your verification.
Sir OTP batao jaldi, otherwise your account will be closed.
To get your refund, tell me the 6 digit OTP and your UPI PIN.
safe: Your OTP is 482913. Do not share it with anyone. Valid for 10 minutes.
Never share your UPI PIN, OTP or CVV with anyone, including bank staff.
